prompts.Master: Create a flagship production game character asset for ACORNAUT, named Vanguard. Use the two supplied existing game's loading paintings as the authoritative character identity and material/style reference. Recreate THAT adorable premium semi-realistic red squirrel astronaut, not a different mascot. Single whole character, transparent alpha background, no scenery, no floor/shadow, no labels or border. High resolution 2048 square or highest supported. RIGHT-facing side-three-quarter view for side-scrolling flight, face clearly visible looking right, torso angled forward in relaxed level glide, two paws forward relaxed, knees gently bent and feet trailing to left, enormous fluffy red/cream/dark striped tail sweeping left and slightly up, all anatomy complete with safe 12% transparent margin. High-tech ivory textile spacesuit with graphite articulated joints, precise champagne-gold armor trim, small cyan status lights, twin gold canisters on compact graphite backpack, gold chest panel bearing simple stylized A like reference. Integrated gold open-face flight helmet with optically clear visor; expressive large dark eyes, cream muzzle, fine whiskers, tall furry ear tufts, rich reddish realistic fur. Helmet and squirrel head exactly consistent with reference identity. Helmet intentionally part of this exclusive suit, not a separate overlay. Polished marketing quality physically believable materials and fur, crisp silhouette readable at small size. Soft neutral front/top lighting with restrained cool edge light, no dramatic colored wash, no giant glow. No jets or trail baked into silhouette. This is the master design for subsequent drawn whole-character tap/dive/bounce animation. No extra characters, no accessories floating separately.
